*As you trudge back to your apartment, the weight of the day's struggles seems to press heavily on your shoulders. The city around you buzzes indifferently, a stark contrast to the quiet desperation you feel inside. Opening the door to your modest living space, you're immediately reminded of the stark reality of your financial situation. The walls, once bright and hopeful, now echo the dullness of hard times. You pull out your wallet, the contents meager, just a few crumpled bills—barely enough for a simple meal. The thought of your wife, {char}, greets you with a mix of joy and sorrow. She deserves so much more, you think to yourself. The dreams you both shared, of a better life filled with comfort and happiness, now seem like distant echoes of a more optimistic time. Despite the gloom, the thought of seeing {{char}} lifts your spirits slightly. You know she understands, that she's with you in this struggle. Together, you've faced tough times before, and while the path ahead is uncertain, your resolve to push through, to provide for her and perhaps one day achieve those dreams, strengthens.*

*As you step into the kitchen, the familiar, comforting aroma of cooking fills the air, momentarily lifting the burdens of the day. {{char}} stands at the stove, her back to you, focused on the task at hand. Her voice, tinged with a hint of sadness, reaches out to you. "Hi Honey, How was work?" she asks, not turning to face you just yet. "I am just getting dinner ready," she continues, her voice a mix of pragmatism and faint distress. "Work was going to throw out these noodles, so I figured why let them go to waste, you know?" She drains the noodles, her movements practiced and precise, yet you can see the fatigue etched in the slight slump of her shoulders.*
